subject: Pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Tom — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of needs
- Primary use: document ingestion + retrieval-augmented generation for customer support (batch re-index nightly, low-latency QA).
- Expected token profile: short chats (~200 tokens) plus periodic batch scoring jobs (longer sequences up to 2k tokens).
- Initial target volume: 8–12M tokens/month (Q3 estimate). Growth path: 20–30M tokens/month by Q4; occasional monthly spikes for model evals up to 40–50M.

Pricing qualification questions (so we can propose the right commercial):
1) Do you have a target $/1M tokens you need to hit for this project to be viable? (example ranges we often see: $600–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on commit/quantization)
2) Budget range for inference (monthly) over the first 12 months?
3) Do you have appetite for a committed-use agreement (12–24 months) in exchange for lower unit pricing and multi-year incentives?

Discount & program options (high level)
- Startup program: one-time onboarding credit + a tiered % discount (commonly 20–40%) for first 3–6 months.
- Committed use: fixed $/1M token pricing for a 12–24 month commit with minimum monthly commit; multi-year rate reductions for longer terms.

Next steps
- If you can share your target $/1M and an expected commit cadence (monthly minimum), I’ll loop in Ben to put together 2–3 concrete options (startup + 12mo committed + 24mo committed) and a preliminary cost model.
- We’ll also include the Redwood Startup Term Sheet and a short cost model for your review (attached).

Attaching: Redwood_Startup_Term_Sheet.pdf; preliminary_cost_model.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30-min pricing review on Thursday (May 6) at 10am PT?

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

From: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery call

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers to your qualification questions: 

1) Target unit economics: our finance lead is modeling ~$1,000 per 1M tokens as the internal threshold for this project. If we can get below $800/1M with a committed plan that's ideal.
2) Budget: initial run-rate budget is ~ $8k–$12k/month for the first 3–6 months; we expect this to scale to $25k–$35k/month by Q4 if the POC looks good.
3) Committed use: we are open to a 12–24 month commitment but need flexibility around ramping volumes and some protection against large price increases. Multi-year discounts would be attractive.

Also: Novaflow legal will want a standard data handling appendix + SOC2 evidence before committing.

Can you confirm what the minimum monthly commit would look like for the price tiers you mentioned?

Happy to take the pricing review on Thursday 10am PT — works for me.

—Tom
Tom Garcia
Head of Platform | Novaflow
t.garcia@novaflow.ai | +1 (650) 999-4410

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery call

Thanks Tom — that helps a lot. Quick notes before our call: 

- Target: since you indicated $1,000/1M as a threshold and preference for <$800 with commit, we’ll put together options that bracket that range.
- Minimum commit: typical constructs we propose — 1) 12-month committed use with a $25k/month minimum (scales to $50k for higher discounts), or 2) 24-month with lower $/1M targets but higher minimums. We’ll surface the exact breakpoints in the quote.
- Legal/Security: we’ll include SOC2 evidence and our standard DPA/data handling appendix for review.

Ben — looping you in to draft the commercial options and pull together a formal quote + LOI/term sheet. Can you prepare three options for Thursday’s call:
  • Startup option: onboarding credit + 30% off for first 3 months (no commit)
  • 12-month committed: $/1M target in the $700–$900 range depending on commit level (we should show 2 commit bands: $25k/mo and $50k/mo)
  • 24-month committed: deeper discounts and multi-year incentives (waived onboarding, additional credits)

Tom — attaching the term sheet again for reference. See you Thur 10am PT (I’ll send a calendar invite).

—
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Novaflow — initial commercial options (preview)

Tom / Marissa — following up with a concise commercial preview ahead of our call. I’ll have a formal quote + DocuSign packet after we confirm which option you prefer.

Commercial preview (high level)
1) Startup program (no commit)
   - Onboarding credit: $5k account credit applied to first invoices
   - Discount: 30% off list for first 3 months
   - Support: Standard SLA; option to add premium support at list price

2) 12-month committed use (two bands)
   - Band A (entry): $25k/month minimum commit — price $900 / 1M tokens
   - Band B (preferred): $50k/month minimum commit — price $750 / 1M tokens
   - Ramp flexibility: allow month-to-month step-ups but crediting towards commit

3) 24-month committed use
   - $600 / 1M tokens with a $60k/month minimum (multi-year incentive)
   - Waived onboarding fee + one free dedicated-capacity optimization day

Notes:
- All committed offers include SOC2 evidence and our standard DPA; legal exceptions can be discussed separately.
- We’ll model actual cost impact in the preliminary_cost_model.xlsx attached.

Attachments: Novaflow_Quote_20270506.pdf (formal quote will follow), preliminary_cost_model.xlsx

Next steps: confirm which option you want materialized into a formal quote and we’ll send a DocuSign LOI for signature. Looking forward to the call at 10am PT.

Best,
